description: This file declares functions related to generating boot configuration arguments from a Cuttlefish configuration object. It includes function prototypes for extracting and formatting boot configuration arguments as string or map, along with relevant includes and namespace encapsulation.
published: Result<std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>> BootconfigArgsFromConfig(const CuttlefishConfig&, const CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific&)
Result<std::string> BootconfigArgsString(const std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>&, const std::string&)

methods.name: BootconfigArgsFromConfig
methods.description: Generates boot configuration arguments as a map of key-value pairs from the provided Cuttlefish configuration object and its instance-specific subset.

methods.name: BootconfigArgsString
methods.description: Converts a map of boot configuration arguments into a single string with a specified separator.
